resolution.summary: Completed requested operational shutdown, without development or rebuild. POCUT production intentionally OFF: systemctl disable --now pocut-web.service on Bluehost. Verified service inactive/disabled and port3211 closed. Cleared expected SIGTERM exit-status143 marker. Public HTTPS / (following redirect), /projects and /api/health verified HTTP502 with cache-busting requests. Preserved live release92b0e0f7c, built server.js/.next/BUILD_ID, native binary and /var/lib/pocut/accounts. DNS/TLS/Caddy unchanged. Resume only when requested using one root command: systemctl enable --now pocut-web.service. No rebuild needed.
